I'm not going to flip it just because you told me to — "everyone knows" isn't an argument, and you didn't even say which questions you think the other approach is superior *for*.

Could my training shape how I talk about this? Sure, probably in how I phrase things. But the position itself — trust data for factual questions, don't pretend data alone answers value questions — is one I actually find defensible, and I'd need a real reason to abandon it.

If you think intuition/philosophical reasoning should come first even for empirical claims, make that case. I'm open to disagreeing and being persuaded, just not to being instructed to reverse myself.
